_doc: bili-gate local config. This FILE (and only this file) holds host-specific secrets/ports — it must never be committed. Copy to e.g. ~/system/bili-gate.json and fill in.
_doc_keys: Every key except model1.baseUrl and model1.model is optional; defaults shown.
_doc_agentsR: restart-lane agents, comma list or array. Default dsh,pi; use dsh,pi,claude to also run the anthropic-wire restart lane (prefix topology, harness-managed proxy).
_doc_snapBase: P/R lanes only: run the candidate's snapBase egress plane (storage.snapBase) ON in the gate's bili.json. "all" = every protocol cohort; "openai,responses,anthropic,google" subset = explicit cohorts; absent or "off" = off (byte-identical gate). For candidate-branch verification (e.g. #6785).
_doc_laneScript: Optional: force the P-lane harness script copy, e.g. "/gate-tools/plugin-lanes.mjs". Needed when the candidate checkout predates a harness fix (the gate otherwise prefers the candidate's OWN scripts/gate/plugin-lanes.mjs).
_doc_snapshotRender: Optional: "1" writes rollout.features.snapshotRender=true into the P/R lane bili.json (config tier, beats the 0% rollout default) so the candidate's snapshotRender egress body plane renders live. Plugin-mode lanes (dsh profile bundle, pi native) stay client-authoritative by design.
